verses.en: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
verses.pt: Quando, pois, o Senhor soube que os fariseus tinham ouvido dizer que ele, Jesus, fazia e batizava mais discípulos do que João
verses.en_web: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
verses.en_bbe: Now when it was clear to the Lord that word had come to the ears of the Pharisees that Jesus was making more disciples than John and was giving them baptism

verses.en: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
verses.pt: (ainda que Jesus mesmo não batizava, mas os seus discípulos)
verses.en_web: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
verses.en_bbe: (Though, in fact, it was his disciples who gave baptism, not Jesus himself),

verses.en: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.
verses.pt: deixou a Judéia, e foi outra vez para a Galiléia.
verses.en_web: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.
verses.en_bbe: He went out of Judaea into Galilee again.

verses.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
verses.pt: E era-lhe necessário passar por Samária.
verses.en_web: He needed to pass through Samaria.
verses.en_bbe: And it was necessary for him to go through Samaria.

verses.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.pt: Chegou, pois, a uma cidade de Samária, chamada Sicar, junto da herdade que Jacó dera a seu filho José;
verses.en_web: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.
verses.en_bbe: So he came to a town of Samaria which was named Sychar, near to the bit of land which Jacob gave to his son Joseph:

verses.en: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
verses.pt: achava-se ali o poço de Jacó. Jesus, pois, cansado da viagem, sentou-se assim junto do poço; era cerca da hora sexta.
verses.en_web: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.en_bbe: Now Jacob's fountain was there. Jesus, being tired after his journey, was resting by the fountain. It was about the sixth hour.

verses.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
verses.pt: Veio uma mulher de Samária tirar água. Disse-lhe Jesus: Dá- me de beber.
verses.en_web: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
verses.en_bbe: A woman of Samaria came to get water, and Jesus said to her, Give me some water.

verses.en: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
verses.pt: Pois seus discípulos tinham ido à cidade comprar comida.
verses.en_web: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.en_bbe: For his disciples had gone to the town to get food.

verses.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe então a mulher samaritana: Como, sendo tu judeu, me pedes de beber a mim, que sou mulher samaritana? (Porque os judeus não se comunicavam com os samaritanos.)
verses.en_web: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
verses.en_bbe: The woman of Samaria said to him, Why do you, a Jew, make a request for water to me, a woman of Samaria? She said this because Jews have nothing to do with the people of Samaria.

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Se tivesses conhecido o dom de Deus e quem é o que te diz: Dá-me de beber, tu lhe terias pedido e ele te haveria dado água viva.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
verses.en_bbe: In answer Jesus said, If you had knowledge of what God gives freely and who it is who says to you, Give me water, you would make your prayer to him, and he would give you living water.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
verses.pt: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, tu não tens com que tirá-la, e o poço é fundo; donde, pois, tens essa água viva?
verses.en_web: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
verses.en_bbe: The woman said to him, Sir, you have no vessel and the fountain is deep; from where will you get the living water?

verses.en: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
verses.pt: És tu, porventura, maior do que o nosso pai Jacó, que nos deu o poço, do qual também ele mesmo bebeu, e os filhos, e o seu gado?.
verses.en_web: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?”
verses.en_bbe: Are you greater than our father Jacob who gave us the fountain and took the water of it himself, with his children and his cattle?

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
verses.pt: Replicou-lhe Jesus: Todo o que beber desta água tornará a ter sede;
verses.en_web: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to her, Everyone who takes this water will be in need of it again:

verses.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
verses.pt: mas aquele que beber da água que eu lhe der nunca terá sede; pelo contrário, a água que eu lhe der se fará nele uma fonte de água que jorre para a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
verses.en_bbe: But whoever takes the water I give him will never be in need of drink again; for the water I give him will become in him a fountain of eternal life.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, dá-me dessa água, para que não mais tenha sede, nem venha aqui tirá-la.
verses.en_web: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
verses.en_bbe: The woman said to him, Sir, give me this water, so that I may not be in need again of drink and will not have to come all this way for it.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vai, chama o teu marido e vem cá.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to her, Go, get your husband and come back here with him.

verses.en: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
verses.pt: Respondeu a mulher: Não tenho marido. Disse-lhe Jesus: Disseste bem: Não tenho marido;
verses.en_web: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
verses.en_bbe: In answer, the woman said, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You have said rightly, I have no husband:

verses.en: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
verses.pt: porque cinco maridos tiveste, e o que agora tens não é teu marido; isso disseste com verdade.
verses.en_web: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
verses.en_bbe: You have had five husbands, and the man you have now is not your husband: that was truly said.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, vejo que és profeta.
verses.en_web: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.en_bbe: The woman said to him, Sir, I see that you are a prophet.

verses.en: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
verses.pt: Nossos pais adoraram neste monte, e vós dizeis que em Jerusalém é o lugar onde se deve adorar.
verses.en_web: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
verses.en_bbe: Our fathers gave worship on this mountain, but you Jews say that the right place for worship is in Jerusalem.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, crê-me, a hora vem, em que nem neste monte, nem em Jerusalém adorareis o Pai.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to her, Woman, take my word for this; the time is coming when you will not give worship to the Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.

verses.en: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
verses.pt: Vós adorais o que não conheceis; nós adoramos o que conhecemos; porque a salvação vem dos judeus.
verses.en_web: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.en_bbe: You give worship, but without knowledge of what you are worshipping: we give worship to what we have knowledge of: for salvation comes from the Jews.

verses.en: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
verses.pt: Mas a hora vem, e agora é, em que os verdadeiros adoradores adorarão o Pai em espírito e em verdade; porque o Pai procura a tais que assim o adorem.
verses.en_web: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
verses.en_bbe: But the time is coming, and is even now here, when the true worshippers will give worship to the Father in the true way of the spirit, for these are the worshippers desired by the Father.

verses.en: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
verses.pt: Deus é Espírito, e é necessário que os que o adoram o adorem em espírito e em verdade.
verses.en_web: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
verses.en_bbe: God is Spirit: then let his worshippers give him worship in the true way of the spirit.

verses.en: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
verses.pt: Replicou-lhe a mulher: Eu sei que vem o Messias (que se chama o Cristo); quando ele vier há de nos anunciar todas as coisas.
verses.en_web: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
verses.en_bbe: The woman said to him, I am certain that the Messiah, who is named Christ, is coming; when he comes he will make all things clear to us.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
verses.pt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu o sou, eu que falo contigo.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to her, I, who am talking to you, am he.

verses.en: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
verses.pt: E nisto vieram os seus discípulos, e se admiravam de que estivesse falando com uma mulher; todavia nenhum lhe perguntou: Que é que procuras? ou: Por que falas com ela?
verses.en_web: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
verses.en_bbe: At that point the disciples came back, and they were surprised to see him talking to a woman; but not one of them said to him, What is your purpose? or, Why are you talking to her?

verses.en: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
verses.pt: Deixou, pois, a mulher o seu cântaro, foi à cidade e disse àqueles homens:
verses.en_web: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,
verses.en_bbe: Then the woman put down her water-pot and went into the town, and said to the people,

verses.en: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
verses.pt: Vinde, vede um homem que me disse tudo quanto eu tenho feito; será este, porventura, o Cristo?
verses.en_web: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
verses.en_bbe: Come and see a man who has been talking to me of everything I ever did! Is it possible that this is the Christ?

verses.en: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
verses.pt: Saíram, pois, da cidade e vinham ter com ele.
verses.en_web: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
verses.en_bbe: So they went out of the town and came to him.

verses.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
verses.pt: Entrementes os seus discípulos lhe rogavam, dizendo: Rabi, come.
verses.en_web: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
verses.en_bbe: While this was taking place, the disciples were saying to Jesus, Master, take some food.

verses.en: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
verses.pt: Ele, porém, respondeu: Uma comida tenho para comer que vós não conheceis.
verses.en_web: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
verses.en_bbe: But he said to them, I have food of which you have no knowledge.

verses.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
verses.pt: Então os discípulos diziam uns aos outros: Acaso alguém lhe trouxe de comer?
verses.en_web: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
verses.en_bbe: So the disciples said one to another, Did anyone give him food?

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes Jesus: A minha comida é fazer a vontade daquele que me enviou, e completar a sua obra.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said, My food is to do the pleasure of him who sent me and to make his work complete.

verses.en: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
verses.pt: Não dizeis vós: Ainda há quatro meses até que venha a ceifa? Ora, eu vos digo: levantai os vossos olhos, e vede os campos, que já estão brancos para a ceifa.
verses.en_web: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest?’ Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
verses.en_bbe: You would say, Four months from now is the time of the grain-cutting. Take a look, I say to you, at the fields; they are even now white for cutting.

verses.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
verses.pt: Quem ceifa já está recebendo recompensa e ajuntando fruto para a vida eterna; para que o que semeia e o que ceifa juntamente se regozijem.
verses.en_web: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
verses.en_bbe: He who does the cutting now has his reward; he is getting together fruit for eternal life, so that he who did the planting and he who gets in the grain may have joy together.

verses.en: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
verses.pt: Porque nisto é verdadeiro o ditado: Um é o que semeia, e outro o que ceifa.
verses.en_web: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
verses.en_bbe: In this the saying is a true one, One does the planting, and another gets in the grain.

verses.en: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
verses.pt: Eu vos enviei a ceifar onde não trabalhaste; outros trabalharam, e vós entrastes no seu trabalho.
verses.en_web: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
verses.en_bbe: I sent you to get in grain which you had no hand in planting: other men did that work, and you take the reward.

verses.en: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
verses.pt: E muitos samaritanos daquela cidade creram nele, por causa da palavra da mulher, que testificava: Ele me disse tudo quanto tenho feito.
verses.en_web: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I did.”
verses.en_bbe: Now a number of the people of that town had faith in him because of the woman's witness: He has been talking to me of everything I ever did.

verses.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
verses.pt: Indo, pois, ter com ele os samaritanos, rogaram-lhe que ficasse com eles; e ficou ali dois dias.
verses.en_web: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
verses.en_bbe: So when the people came to him they made request to him to be among them for a time, and he was there two days.

verses.en: And many more believed because of his own word;
verses.pt: E muitos mais creram por causa da palavra dele;
verses.en_web: Many more believed because of his word.
verses.en_bbe: And a great number more of them came to have faith in him because of what he himself said.

verses.en: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
verses.pt: e diziam à mulher: Já não é pela tua palavra que nós cremos; pois agora nós mesmos temos ouvido e sabemos que este é verdadeiramente o Salvador do mundo.
verses.en_web: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to the woman, Now we have faith, but not because of your story: we ourselves have given ear to his words, and we are certain that he is truly the Saviour of the world.

verses.en: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
verses.pt: Passados os dois dias partiu dali para a Galiléia.
verses.en_web: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
verses.en_bbe: And after the two days he went on from there into Galilee.

verses.en: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
verses.pt: Porque Jesus mesmo testificou que um profeta não recebe honra na sua própria pátria.
verses.en_web: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.en_bbe: For Jesus himself said that a prophet has no honour in the country of his birth.

verses.en: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, que chegou à Galiléia, os galileus o receberam, porque tinham visto todas as coisas que fizera em Jerusalém na ocasião da festa; pois também eles tinham ido à festa.
verses.en_web: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
verses.en_bbe: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilaeans took him to their hearts because of the things which they had seen him do in Jerusalem at the feast--they themselves having been there at the feast.

verses.en: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.pt: Foi, então, outra vez a Caná da Galiléia, onde da água fizera vinho. Ora, havia um oficial do rei, cujo filho estava enfermo em Cafarnaum.
verses.en_web: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
verses.en_bbe: So he came to Cana in Galilee, where he had made the water wine. And there was a certain man of high position whose son was ill at Capernaum.

verses.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
verses.pt: Quando ele soube que Jesus tinha vindo da Judéia para a Galiléia, foi ter com ele, e lhe rogou que descesse e lhe curasse o filho; pois estava à morte.
verses.en_web: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.en_bbe: When it came to his ears that Jesus had come from Judaea into Galilee, he went to him and made a request that he would come down to his son, who was near to death, and make him well.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
verses.pt: Então Jesus lhe disse: Se não virdes sinais e prodígios, de modo algum crereis.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus said to him, You will not have faith if you do not see signs and wonders.

verses.en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
verses.pt: Rogou-lhe o oficial: Senhor, desce antes que meu filho morra.
verses.en_web: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
verses.en_bbe: The man said, Sir, come down before my boy is dead.

verses.en: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Vai, o teu filho vive. E o homem creu na palavra que Jesus lhe dissera, e partiu.
verses.en_web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said, Go in peace; your son is living. The man had faith in the word which Jesus said to him and went away.

verses.en: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
verses.pt: Quando ele já ia descendo, saíram-lhe ao encontro os seus servos, e lhe disseram que seu filho vivia.
verses.en_web: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
verses.en_bbe: And while he was going down, his servants came to him and said, Your boy is living.

verses.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
verses.pt: Perguntou-lhes, pois, a que hora começara a melhorar; ao que lhe disseram: Ontem à hora sétima a febre o deixou.
verses.en_web: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
verses.en_bbe: So he put a question to them as to the hour when he became better; and they said to him, The disease went from him yesterday at the seventh hour.

verses.en: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
verses.pt: Reconheceu, pois, o pai ser aquela hora a mesma em que Jesus lhe dissera: O teu filho vive; e creu ele e toda a sua casa.
verses.en_web: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
verses.en_bbe: It was clear then to the father that this was the very time at which Jesus said to him, Your son is living. And he had faith in Jesus, he and all his family.

verses.en: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
verses.pt: Foi esta a segunda vez que Jesus, ao voltar da Judéia para a Galiléia, ali operou sinal.
verses.en_web: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
verses.en_bbe: Now this is the second sign which Jesus did after he had come out of Judaea into Galilee.
